[ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided a step-by-step guide for installing the showerhead, including tools needed: adjustable wrench or basin wrench, channel-type pliers (optional), and Teflon tape (optional).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Installation steps include turning off the water supply, removing the old showerhead, inspecting and cleaning the shower arm, applying Teflon tape (optional), installing the new showerhead, tightening it, turning on the water supply, and testing the showerhead.
